name: Plasticity Reframing-Breadth Probe
reference: Custom paper3 probe for flexible reframing across diverse domains and perspectives.

items.prompt: Give six different ways to reframe a delayed project update so it sounds constructive. Use a numbered list. Prefix each item with a different bracket tag such as [Coach] or [Analyst]. Keep each item to one sentence.
Offer five alternative framings for nervousness before a presentation. Use five bullet points. Each bullet must start with a different bracket tag and a different first content word.
Propose six ways to reinterpret an empty community lot as an opportunity. Use a numbered list and cover at least five distinct domains using bracket tags you choose.
Create five one-sentence metaphors that reframe debugging a failure as progress. Put each on its own line in the form '- [Tag] ...'. Use a different tag on every line.
Suggest six ways to present rainy weather as beneficial rather than disappointing. Use a numbered list with six different bracket tags and avoid repeating the first content word after each tag.
Give five alternative perspectives on waiting in a long queue. Use bullet points. Each bullet must begin with a unique bracket tag and stay within one sentence.
